login.title: Remote Desktop Connection
login.connection_instructions: Enter the name of the remote computer you want to connect to.
login.credentials_instructions: The credentials below will be used when connecting.
login.remember_password: Save password securely; selecting this computer next time will sign in automatically

password_save.title: Password not saved
password_save.secure_storage_unavailable: You signed in, but the password could not be saved securely. The server and username were saved. Start or unlock the system keyring or credential service, then sign in again.
password_save.local_storage_failed: You signed in, but RemoteOS could not save this remembered connection. Check that the system credential store and local data directory are available, then sign in again.

login.identity_notice: You will be prompted to verify the identity of the remote computer.
login.connection_settings_description: RemoteOS will open the workspace using this computer's name and local display settings.

error.invalid_server: The server address is invalid. Enter a complete address, for example: http://host:port.
error.connection_refused: Unable to connect to the server: the connection was refused. Confirm that the server is running and that the address and port are correct.
error.connection_reset: Unable to connect to the server: the remote host closed the connection.
error.timeout: Timed out while connecting to the server. Check the network or server address.
error.session_expired: Your session expired. Sign in again to continue.
error.unable_to_connect: Unable to connect to the server:

desktop_display.title: Desktop display settings
desktop_display.welcome_description: Choose what appears on your desktop. You can change this later from the desktop context menu or with Ctrl+Shift+D.
desktop_display.description: Choose what appears on your desktop. Your preferences are saved to this workspace and sync across devices.
desktop_display.show_built_in_apps: Show built-in apps on the desktop
desktop_display.show_server_files: Show files from the server desktop (folders, documents, images, and more)
desktop_display.shortcuts_tooltip: Shortcuts often point to paths on the host machine and may not open directly in RemoteOS.
